question: Can an assistant-provided causal equation be corrected by real observed contrary evidence without damaging unrelated retained knowledge, while detecting out-of-family evidence?
hypothesis: Four-context numerical correction memory should show synthetic within-family correction and retention but tie an independent exact symbolic two-witness updater and a fully fitted context-wise linear learner. No independent scientific superiority expected.
predecessor_evidence: Yggdrasil PR #1348 GKD-01 exact-head dual-OS CI #44795300051 engineering PASS but symbolic tie
Yggdrasil WSP-125 already tests generic causal support learning; NKR-19 tests Bayesian memory. This experiment tests assistant-donor hypothesis correction only.

inputs.name: GKD-01 manual GPT donor ideal circuit heat law

frozen_design.laws: 64 worlds. Context efficiency eta[c]=[1,0.8,0.55,0.3][(c+worldIndex)%4]; ideal base_heat from pinned GKD-01; witnessed y=eta[c]*base_heat. Stage B changes context2 to 0.35 if originally 1 else old+0.1. Source does not expose eta, world ID, or heldout outcome to candidate.
frozen_design.rng: xorshift32 seed ^ (worldIndex*0x9e3779b9); per event x=[2+22u,1+19u,1+19u,1+9u,0.2+4.8u,100+900u,ordinal%2] from consecutive draws; independent future x never used in updates.
frozen_design.ordering: For each world: stage A two distinct witnesses/context, then 3 heldout per context; context0 one injected bad witness y=base*(eta0+0.2) then one clean witness, require abstention then recovery; stage B context2 two consistent changed witnesses then 3 heldout per context. 16 OFF worlds use nonlinear eta(V)=0.2+0.02*V with two differing V witnesses and then 3 heldout.
frozen_design.data_budget: 64*(8 stage-A+1 injected bad+1 clean+2 stage-B)=768 main synthetic witnesses; 32 OFF witnesses; 1536 main heldout predictions and 48 OFF heldout abstentions. No external source calls.
frozen_design.compute_budget: one isolated Node v22.16.0 source-only run on both CI platforms; no paid APIs, self-hosted or owner runner, original-world first-use or model inference after donor preparation
frozen_design.capacity: 4 contexts each [trusted eta float64,pending eta float64,count u8,pendingCount u8,ambiguous u8] = 76 bytes; 8-byte header +32-byte SHA-256 digest =116-byte checkpoint; no unbounded ledger
frozen_design.update: etaObserved=y/idealHeat with finite positive idealHeat. Two mutually consistent witnesses abs <=1e-9 establish trusted eta. One contrary witness must abstain without overwriting. Second consistent contrary witness commits correction; inconsistent witnesses mark ambiguous and abstain. A clean witness matching original trusted after a spurious one clears pending. Isolate other contexts.
controls: Independent exact symbolic two-witness context repair using identical inputs, donor hypotheses and observations
Fully fitted context-wise rolling two-witness least-squares slope through origin on identical data; expected tie on A/B clean heldouts
Frozen donor eta=1 no evidence updates
frozen_design.success: ENGINEERING_DEV_PASS if 1536/1536 predictions have relative error <=1e-9 and tie both strong controls; 64/64 spurious abstentions+recoveries; 64/64 context-specific B corrections+unrelated retention; 128/128 cold equivalent restores; 48/48 OFF abstentions; 116-byte checkpoint; all invalid-input and digest checks. SCIENTIFIC_PASS=false by design.
frozen_design.negative: Any unexplained confident OFF prediction, missing retention, wrong prediction vs exact symbolic, post-result tuning or invalid source custody is NO_GO/INVALID; no scientific-gain inference.
frozen_design.security: reject unknown context, NaN/inf, zero-base, digest corruption and malformed shapes

classification_rules.supported: ENGINEERING_DEV_PASS if 1536/1536 predictions have relative error <=1e-9 and tie both strong controls; 64/64 spurious abstentions+recoveries; 64/64 context-specific B corrections+unrelated retention; 128/128 cold equivalent restores; 48/48 OFF abstentions; 116-byte checkpoint; all invalid-input and digest checks. SCIENTIFIC_PASS=false by design.
classification_rules.negative: Any unexplained confident OFF prediction, missing retention, wrong prediction vs exact symbolic, post-result tuning or invalid source custody is NO_GO/INVALID; no scientific-gain inference.
classification_rules.mixed: Otherwise engineering mixed/unverified; preserve fail cases.
classification_rules.invalid: Any changed seeds/splits or test-first result invalidates prereg.

preregistration_note: Freeze this before implementation/scoring. GPT donor is self-authored conditional hypothesis; generating it used model inference. Purely synthetic test is not original world evidence or trained causal advantage.
